analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI attempting rebound after entering oversold territory, but ADX at 30.5 indicates a clear trend, with -DI (34.9) exceeding +DI (21.1), suggesting downward pressure dominance. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, indicating recovery potential, but the SMA20 (KRW 82,756) acts as a strong resistance. With ATR at KRW 7,808, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR (KRW 10,150) from entry at KRW 72,545 would be KRW 62,395, and a target of KRW 90,000 results in a risk-reward ratio below 1.5.
